description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can breathe air and water.

If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies outside the Elemental Plane of Water, its body dissolves into brine, and it gains a new body in 1d4 days, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere on the Plane of Water.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has a 30 percent chance of knowing the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplWish000000]{Wish} spell. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} knows it, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can understand. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts the spell for the creature, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} suffers none of the spell's stress. Once the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has cast it three times, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't do so again for 365 days.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]):

At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCreateorDe]{Create or Destroy Water}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectEvil]{Detect Evil and Good}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{Detect Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplPurifyFood]{Purify Food and Drink}

1/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplControlWat]{Control Water}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGaseousFor]{Gaseous Form}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplInvisibili]{Invisibility}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplPlaneShift]{Plane Shift}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplTongues000]{Tongues}

Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=iUwbybSS73fOZ9Ab]], each creature in a 60-foot-long, 10-foot-wide Line. Failure: [[/damage 9d6 average type=cold]] damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is pushed up to 20 feet straight away from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} and has the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition. Success: Half damage only.
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFogCloud00]{Fog Cloud}, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
